label.zh: 入侵结果（四选一，按权重）
label.en: Hack result (one of four, by weight)

note.zh: 入侵阶段按权重抽取：成功未被发现 200、成功但被发现 205、失败未被发现 210、失败被发现 215（基础权重各1；对方主动政策使成功类 ×1.33，科技领先 ×1.5；对方谨慎使失败类 ×1.2，科技落后 ×1.5；首次接触技能 2/3/4 使失败类 ×0.9/0.8/0.6）。
note.en: The hacking stage draws by weight (base 1 each): clean success 200, detected success 205, clean failure 210, detected failure 215. A proactive contact multiplies the successes by 1.33, a tech lead by 1.5; a cautious contact multiplies the failures by 1.2, a tech deficit by 1.5; first_contact_skill_2/3/4 scale failures by 0.9/0.8/0.6.

note.zh: 建立通讯，并按此前窃取的内容，复制对方一项物理、社会或工程科技（进度10%）。
note.en: Communications open, and a physics, society or engineering technology matching the earlier theft is copied to 10% progress.

notes.zh: 审阅注：入口为 first_contact.50 的选项C（仅非主动政策可选，AI 偏好系数2）；见 event-first-contact-1 篇。
notes.en: Review note: entered from option C of first_contact.50 (only for non-proactive policy, AI factor 2); see the event-first-contact-1 story.

notes.zh: 审阅注：205 成功但被发现：随后对方收到 206（入侵被发现）；215 失败被发现：对方收到 216（入侵被挫败）。
notes.en: Review note: after a detected success (205) the other side gets 206; after a detected failure (215) it gets 216.

notes.zh: 审阅注：入侵失败但未被发现后，按对方政策回到通用收尾阶段（主动 → proactive，否则 cautious）。
notes.en: Review note: after an undetected failure the stage falls back to the generic end stage (proactive or cautious by the contact’s policy).
